info.name: Dialog API Collection
info.description: Dialog Survey Platform API collection for frontend engineers

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for user registration, authentication, session tokens, and current user identity.

request.description: Create a new user account with email and password. Optionally supply `organization_name` to automatically provision a new business organization with the user as OWNER.
Authenticate with email and password to receive a Sanctum bearer token and user profile.
Retrieve the currently authenticated user's profile and platform role.
Revoke the current access token. For SPA cookie sessions, invalidates the web session.

item.name:
Organizations

Manage business organizations, memberships, and role assignments.

request.description: List all organizations that the authenticated user belongs to.
Create a new organization. The authenticated user automatically becomes the OWNER.
Retrieve details of a specific organization. Requires membership in the organization or platform admin role.
Update organization details. Requires OWNER or MANAGER role in the organization.

item.name:
Results & Analytics

Real-time analytics, response aggregates, respondent participation breakdown, and CSV data export.

query.description: Filter by participation status; omit to include both statuses.
Display language for question and option labels, not a participation filter.

request.description: Returns high-level metrics: total starts, completions, in-progress count, and completion rate percentage.

query.description: Filter by participation status: in_progress or completed.
Filter by stored participation locale: uz, ru or en.
Optional locale to label choice options. Defaults to survey default_locale.

request.description: Returns distribution counts and percentages for choice options, or average rating score and count for rating questions.

query.description: Filter by stored participation locale: uz, ru or en.
Display language for question and option labels, not a participation filter.

request.description: List all respondent participations for the survey with pagination and status filtering.

variable.description: The ID of the participation session.

request.description: Retrieve individual respondent's answers across all questions in the survey.

query.description: Filter by participation status: in_progress or completed.
Filter by stored participation locale: uz, ru or en.
Optional locale for question and option headers. Defaults to survey default_locale.

request.description: Download filtered survey responses as a CSV spreadsheet. Defaults to both completed and in-progress records; pass status=completed for completed-only export.

item.name:
Survey Lifecycle

Manage survey status transitions: submit for review, publish, pause, resume, close, and archive.

request.description: Submit a completed draft survey to the platform moderation queue. Validates translation completeness and question structure.
Activate an APPROVED survey so that respondents can participate. Once published, survey structure becomes immutable.
Temporarily pause an ACTIVE survey. Existing in-progress respondents can finish, but no new participations can be started.
Resume a PAUSED survey back to ACTIVE status.
Permanently close an ACTIVE or PAUSED survey to all responses.
Archive a CLOSED survey. Archived surveys are kept read-only for reporting and historic reference.

item.name:
Preview

Stateless survey preview and test-validation endpoints. Allows business users to preview survey flow in any supported locale without polluting production statistics.

query.description: Survey locale to preview (must be one of survey locales: uz, ru, en). Defaults to survey default_locale.

request.description: Previews the survey flow and initial page in the requested locale. Makes zero database writes.

variable.description: The ID of the page being validated.

request.description: Test-validates answers for a specific page in preview mode without recording responses in the database.

item.name:
Survey Builder (Pages)

Manage survey pages, localized page titles/descriptions, and page sequence.

request.description: Appends a new page to the draft survey. Automatically assigns the next sequential position.
Update page title or description. Survey must be editable (draft or changes requested).
Deletes a page and all its questions and options. A survey must retain at least one page.
Update sequential positions of pages for a survey. Expects an array containing all page IDs in desired sequence.

item.name:
Survey Builder (Questions)

Manage survey questions, types, localized labels, validation settings, and sequencing.

request.description: Create a new question within a survey page. Supported types: single_choice, multiple_choice, rating, short_text, long_text.
Update question properties, localized titles, and type-specific settings. Survey must be editable.
Delete a question and its options from the draft survey.

variable.description: The ID of the question to duplicate.

request.description: Deep-copy a question including its settings and localized options directly below the original question.
Update sequential positions of questions on a given page.

item.name:
Survey Builder (Options)

Manage choice options for single_choice and multiple_choice questions.

request.description: Add a choice option with localized labels to a choice question.
Update localized labels of an existing choice option.
Delete a choice option from a question.
Reorder choice options for a question.

item.name: Respondent
item.description: Core respondent participation flow: starting or resuming surveys, saving page answers, and completing surveys.

variable.description: The ID of the active survey.

request.description: Starts participation in an ACTIVE survey or resumes an in-progress session. Guarantees exactly one participation per user per survey (`UNIQUE(survey_id, user_id)`).

variable.description: The ID of the participation session.

request.description: Load the current survey page and answered state for an in-progress session.

variable.description: The ID of the participation session.
The ID of the page being submitted.

request.description:
Validates and saves answers for the given page. Advances participation to the next page determined by SurveyFlow.

Important: The frontend MUST NOT calculate the next page; the backend SurveyFlow response dictates navigation.

variable.description: The ID of the participation session.

request.description: Finalizes participation session and marks it COMPLETED. Idempotent: repeated calls on an already completed session return success safely.
Returns to the actually visited previous page, not the previous page by position. On the first page this is a no-op.

item.name:
Moderation

Platform moderation queue for reviewing submitted business surveys, approving or requesting changes before publication.

query.description: Filter by status (default is pending_review). Allowed: pending_review, approved, changes_requested.

request.description: List surveys pending review or in other moderation states. Restricted to platform administrators.
Fetch complete survey hierarchy (pages, questions, options, translations, and organization info) for moderation review.
Approve a survey in PENDING_REVIEW status. Transitions status to APPROVED, enabling the business to publish.
Reject or request adjustments for a survey in PENDING_REVIEW status. Requires explanatory feedback comment.
